column5: ganita_paripurna_shesh(a, b)ganita_paripurna_shesh(a, b) — truncating a % b (WS4, R24). Remainder never overflows mathematically (INT64_MIN % -1 is exactly 0), but the hardware operation still traps on MIN % -1 (same SIGFPE as MIN / -1), so this guards that case and returns 0 — which is also the exact result. b == 0 returns 0 (same sentinel as sat_div). Guards before operating, so it never executes a trapping operation.
